kaikki_vikisozluk.e: خَنْدَقَ • (ḵandaqa) Iq (non-past يُخَنْدِقُ (yuḵandiqu), verbal noun خَنْدَقَة (ḵandaqa))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: An Iranian borrowing: compare Persian کندک (kandak), کنده (kanda), Old Armenian քանդակ (kʻandak) (also from Iranian).
g: to dig a trench, to make a trench
to dig a moat, to make a moat
